task.title: Add a base-to-HEAD change-volume helper to evals/metrics.py
task.description: Eval reporting wants the size of the change a run produced — total lines changed and number of files touched — between a base ref and the worktree's HEAD. Add an async helper to `orchestrator/src/orchestrator/evals/metrics.py` that takes a repo path and a base ref, runs `git diff --stat` against `HEAD` in that repo, and returns `(total_lines_changed, file_count)` read off the summary line. It must tolerate an empty diff (base == HEAD) without raising, so a run that changed nothing still reports a number rather than blowing up the metric collector.
task.test_strategy: Unit-test the helper in `orchestrator/tests/test_metrics.py` against a temporary git repo with a known base commit and a controlled set of edits, asserting the returned line and file counts agree with what `git diff --stat` reports for that range. Include the zero-change case.
